⚜️ Name changes can be completed directly through Go&Dance and cost €15.
Simply follow the steps on the Go&Dance platform to submit your request.
Name changes will be possible until 29/04/2027 at 23:59.Your name change will be confirmed once all steps are correctly completed. Name change will be possible until 29/04/2027 at 23h59

⚜️ ⚠️ Please note: All ticket sales (Passes & Hotel rooms) are final and non-refundable.
Once purchased, tickets cannot be cancelled or refunded under any circumstances. However, you may request a name change if you can no longer attend.
